# sampling temperature

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:samplingTemperature`](gmeow-samplingTemperature.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/samplingTemperature>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/ai`](../../slices/ai.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The temperature parameter of this invocation. Sampling parameters are claim provenance: the same prompt at temperature 0 and 1.2 are different epistemic acts.

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:ModelInvocation`](../classes/gmeow-ModelInvocation.md) -> [`xsd:decimal`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#decimal)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:samplingTemperature`](gmeow-samplingTemperature.md) from [`gmeow:ModelInvocation`](../classes/gmeow-ModelInvocation.md) to [`xsd:decimal`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#decimal) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to record the temperature of a [`gmeow:ModelInvocation`](../classes/gmeow-ModelInvocation.md) as part of its provenance — the same prompt at temperature 0 versus 1.2 is a different epistemic act.

### Avoid when

- Avoid placing it on the model agent or card (it is per-invocation, not per-model) and avoid treating it as an output quality score; it is an input setting, claim provenance.

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:samplingTemperature`](gmeow-samplingTemperature.md) as a decimal on the [`gmeow:ModelInvocation`](../classes/gmeow-ModelInvocation.md) alongside [`gmeow:samplingTopP`](gmeow-samplingTopP.md) and [`gmeow:samplingMaxTokens`](gmeow-samplingMaxTokens.md) so the sampling regime is fully recoverable.

### Examples

- ex:inv1 [`gmeow:samplingTemperature`](gmeow-samplingTemperature.md) 0.7.
